Module de.learnlib.filter.symbol
Package de.learnlib.filter.symbol

Class CachedSymbolFilter<U,V>

java.lang.Object
de.learnlib.filter.symbol.CachedSymbolFilter<U,V>
Type Parameters:
U - input symbol type of the prefix
V - input symbol type of the transition label
All Implemented Interfaces:
RefutableSymbolFilter<U,V>, SymbolFilter<U,V>
public class CachedSymbolFilter<U,V> extends Object implements RefutableSymbolFilter<U,V>
Wrapper for a symbol filter that caches previous responses and allows caller to update these.
